items.title: With AI, researchers discover new way to detect sudden cardiac death risk
items.raw_excerpt: A UC Berkeley-led project trained an AI system on hundreds of thousands of EKGs. The resulting risk predictions are much better than existing methods, paving the way to save lives at scale.

title_i18n.en: With AI, researchers discover new way to detect sudden cardiac death risk
title_i18n.zh: 借助人工智能，研究人员发现检测心源性猝死风险的新方法
title_i18n.es: Con la IA, los investigadores descubren una nueva forma de detectar el riesgo de muerte súbita cardíaca

excerpt_i18n.en: A UC Berkeley-led project trained an AI system on hundreds of thousands of EKGs. The resulting risk predictions are much better than existing methods, paving the way to save lives at scale.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一个由加州大学伯克利分校领导的项目在数十万份心电图数据上训练了一个人工智能系统。由此产生的风险预测远优于现有方法，为大规模拯救生命铺平了道路。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un proyecto liderado por UC Berkeley entrenó un sistema de IA con cientos de miles de electrocardiogramas. Las predicciones de riesgo resultantes son mucho mejores que los métodos existentes, allanando el camino para salvar vidas a gran escala.

items.title: AI in mathematics is forcing big questions
items.raw_excerpt: The increasing use of AI in mathematics sparks debates about the nature of proof and discovery. While AI aids in finding new patterns and theorems, concerns over its lack of transparency challenge traditional mathematical rigor.

title_i18n.en: AI in mathematics is forcing big questions
title_i18n.zh: 数学中的人工智能正在引发重大问题
title_i18n.es: La IA en matemáticas está planteando grandes cuestiones.

excerpt_i18n.en: The increasing use of AI in mathematics sparks debates about the nature of proof and discovery. While AI aids in finding new patterns and theorems, concerns over its lack of transparency challenge traditional mathematical rigor.
excerpt_i18n.zh: AI在数学领域的应用日益深入，引发了关于数学本质和验证方法的重大讨论。一些研究者认为AI能帮助发现新定理和模式，但也担忧其‘黑箱’性质可能影响数学证明的严谨性。这场辩论正推动数学界重新思考未来研究的范式。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los investigadores debaten sobre la motivación, el propósito y el futuro del campo.

items.title: 2027 Macs to Get AI-Focused M7 Chips as Apple Skips High-End M6
items.raw_excerpt: Apple is changing its Apple silicon launch timeline to speed up the debut of chips designed for artificial intelligence workloads, reports Bloomberg. Apple plans to release an M6 chip for entry-level Macs as soon as this year, but it has canceled plans for higher-end M6 Pro and M6 Max chips. Instead, Apple's next Pro and Max chips will be part of its M7 chip lineup, with the first M7 chips launching in 2027. An M5 Ultra chip could also come as soon as this year.

title_i18n.es: Los Macs de 2027 obtendrán chips M7 centrados en IA, mientras Apple omite el M6 de gama alta.

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 26, 2026, vivo officially launched its new generation foldable flagship, the vivo X Fold6. Focused on "large screen + AI productivity" and creating task space for AI, the new vivo X Fold6 not only redefines the core value of foldable phones but also marks a milestone for the vivo X Fold series in starting a new chapter of foldable innovation. The vivo X Fold6 is equipped with the industry’s first OriginOS 6 Fold operating system, deeply customized for foldable large screens and designed for task flows. Reconstructed from the ground up, it delivers a new large-screen multitasking interaction, enabling the atomic workbench to support a "serial" mode with five apps on one screen and a "parallel" mode with four windows running simultaneously, allowing AI to join task flows at any time. It also features the industry’s first Blue Crystal x Dimensity 9500 Super Edition flagship chip, deeply customized for foldable large-screen AI task flows and multi-scenario on-device AI. This chip not only delivers extreme performance with high efficiency and low power consumption but also powers on-device AI experiences such as the AI File Manager and AI Meeting Assistant. With deep software-hardware integration, the vivo X Fold6 becomes a powerful "AI companion" that enables users to smoothly run AI task flows on the same screen. Since the advent of foldable screens, continuous advancements in thinness, reliability, imaging, and battery life have completed the "first evolution" marked by hardware maturity. Now, the combination of foldable large screens and AI task flows opens a new chapter in redefining foldable phone experiences.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 26 de junio de 2026, vivo lanzó oficialmente su nuevo plegable insignia, el vivo X Fold6. Centrado en «pantalla grande + productividad con IA», crea un espacio de trabajo para la inteligencia artificial. El nuevo vivo X Fold6 no solo redefine el valor central de los teléfonos plegables, sino que también marca un hito que abre un nuevo capítulo para la serie X Fold. Incorpora el primer sistema operativo del sector, OriginOS 6 Fold, diseñado a medida para pantallas grandes plegables y orientado a flujos de tareas, reestructurado desde la base para ofrecer multitarea en pantalla grande.

title_i18n.es: La IA erosiona el legado de la lectura
